title: Clean User Data Result Schema
description: Result of POST /admin/users/{userId}/clean-data: what the user produced is erased, the account stays. `removed` counts the rows per kind. For `transactions`, `data_access_audits` and `data_revision_actor_links` the rows are KEPT as the audit / history trail and only lose the link to the user, so the count is rows detached, not deleted. History of the user's own records is erased (`data_revisions`, `data_revision_changes`, `data_revision_values`). `form_files` is the number of uploaded files deleted from disk.

scheduled_job_recipients.description: Recipient rows that pointed at the user on other people's scheduled jobs (deleted)

scheduled_jobs.description: Scheduled jobs owned by the user (deleted)

data_revisions.description: Revision events of records owned by the user (deleted)

data_revision_changes.description: Field/language change rows of those revisions (deleted)

data_revision_values.description: Stored revision values of those records (deleted)

data_revision_actor_links.description: Revision actor links on somebody else's records detached from the user; the history rows are kept

data_cells.description: Cells of the user's data rows (deleted)

data_rows.description: Data rows owned by the user (deleted)

transactions.description: Transaction (activity) rows detached from the user; the rows are kept

data_access_audits.description: Data-access audit rows detached from the user; the rows are kept

api_request_logs.description: API request log rows of the user (deleted)

form_files.description: Uploaded form files removed from disk
